title: One-Word Sketch · Pair relay
hook: Find a game, gather your friends and start playing.

knows: The group wants an activity to play together.
doesNotKnow: The setup, turn and ending for this house-rule format.

misconception: The group has to know a complicated rulebook before starting.
objective: Learn how to play One-Word Sketch · Pair relay with friends.

claims.text: Original house rules: A partner writes one familiar object on a hidden slip and gives it to the lead. The lead draws the object without letters, numbers or speech. The other players identify the object. Form pairs. On each pair’s turn, both people make separate attempts with fresh challenges, helping only their partner. The pair earns one point only if both succeed. Each pair has two turns. Highest score wins.
claims.source: Original playable house-rule proposal; not an authoritative ruleset for a traditional game.

claims.text: For this version: 4, 6 or 8 players; materials: Paper and pencil.
claims.source: Proposed setup and player range for this activity.

recall.question: In One-Word Sketch, what counts as a successful turn?
options: The lead skips the turn without attempting it.
The group ends the round before anyone plays.
The other players identify the object.
recall.why: The other players identify the object.
